[!isolates] skip
# One-way writes work in marked builds with enforced ownership and effects.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip

go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o writes$GOEXE ./host
exec ./writes$GOEXE
stdout '^compiled one-way writes passed$'

[cgo] [race] go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -race -gcflags=example.org/isolatewrite/host=-d=isolateheap=2 -o writes-race$GOEXE ./host
[cgo] [race] exec ./writes-race$GOEXE
[cgo] [race] stdout '^compiled one-way writes passed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatewrite
go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import "isolate"

var state = []byte{7}

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Work() {
    state[0]++
    isolate.Write(1, state)
    clear(state)
    for op := uint32(2); op <= 1000; op++ {
        isolate.Write(op, []byte("event"))
    }
    isolate.Write(1001, make([]byte, (64<<10)+1))
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "time"
    "example.org/isolatewrite/jobs"
)

func run(deterministic bool) {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work)
    if !ok { panic("missing function handle") }
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
        if err := h.Invoke(func(...isolate.Value) error { return nil }, func(...isolate.Value) error { return nil }); err != nil { panic(err) }
    })
    clock := time.Unix(0, 0)
    instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Deterministic: deterministic, InitialTime: &clock, TimerOp: 77})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    select {
    case <-instance.Done():
    case <-time.After(5*time.Second): panic("writes waited for host receipt or acknowledgment")
    }
    if err := instance.Wait(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    if instance.PendingCalls() != 0 || instance.DroppedWrites() != 937 { panic("unexpected pending calls or dropped writes") }
    for op := uint32(1); op <= 64; op++ {
        message := <-instance.Writes()
        if message.Op != op { panic("write order changed") }
        if op == 1 {
            if len(message.Payload) != 1 || message.Payload[0] != 8 { panic("state shared or payload not copied") }
        } else if string(message.Payload) != "event" { panic("payload changed") }
    }
    select {
    case <-instance.Commands(): panic("Write created a reply command")
    default:
    }
}

func main() {
    for _, deterministic := range []bool{false, true} {
        run(deterministic)
        run(deterministic)
    }
    fmt.Println("compiled one-way writes passed")
}
